label: sec:breit-wheeler-pair-creation-intro
html: At high photon energies, the Breit–Wheeler process \gamma\gamma \to e^+e^- tests the elementary Hecke vertex where two unknotted photonic flux modes fuse into a conjugate electron–positron trefoil pair. This section computes the topological crossing-energy threshold of electron–positron conversion and compares the categorical cross-section prediction against direct relativistic heavy-ion and laser-collider Breit–Wheeler observations.
